_scoring_note: New mechanism: rank each factor WITHIN the category (1=best on that factor), mirror it so higher=better, weight, sum -> composite. Highest composite = #1 = best fund. Weights below are the team default; each visitor can adjust their own in the site. 'dir' says whether a LOWER value is better (cost, risk) or HIGHER (sharpe, ir, cagr).

sharpe.label: Sharpe
sharpe.better: more reward per unit of total risk

ir.label: Info ratio
ir.better: reward per unit of tracking error (Alpha / TE)

treynor.label: Treynor
treynor.better: reward per unit of market risk

_how_to_add_a_category: Add a display-name -> list-of-AMFI-sections entry to include_categories, e.g. "Value cap": ["Value Fund"]. To remove one, delete its entry. To force a fund in even if its category is excluded, add its AMFI scheme code to include_codes.
_categories_note: Keys are the tab names shown on the site. Values are AMFI section fragments from NAVAll.txt. Add/remove a key (or one of its fragments) to add/remove a whole category; the tabs update themselves.
_plan_rule: Keep GROWTH option only. Prefer preferred_plan, fall back to plan_fallback when a fund has no preferred plan.
_aum_note: No reachable source publishes per-fund AUM, so the AUM>=500cr screen is not auto-applied. The category filter above already removes most tiny funds. To hard-filter by a curated AUM list, drop an aum.csv (scheme_code,aum_crores) next to this file and set aum_filter_crores.
